metadata.title: Real-mode greenfield microservices on Azure (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: New multi-tenant retail API platform built as microservices with external consumers onboarding through a managed API layer.
reviewObjectives: Confirm ingress and east-west security boundaries
Validate identity patterns avoid static secrets at runtime
Highlight scaling risks before Black Friday launch
constraints: Must support 50k RPS spike with <200ms p95 external latency
PCI SAQ-A scope for payment widgets only (out of scope for core APIs)

inputSummary: Greenfield AKS microservices behind API Management with workload identities and mesh-style mTLS assumptions. Synthetic brief for cohort diversity vs brownfield no-gateway mesh.

qualityEvidence.notes: Distinct from corpus-real-mode-microservices (no edge gateway); exemplar is synthetic Web AgentResult JSON.
